description: Scan a single file on disk by path for security vulnerabilities. Pass a file path — the tool reads the file itself. For inline code snippets, use check_code instead. The 'agent' format returns the structured guardvibe.agent.v1 contract (finding + exact edit + confidence + verify step). Example: scan_file({file_path: 'src/api/route.ts', format: 'agent'})

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

format.description: Output format. 'agent' = machine-actionable guardvibe.agent.v1 (exact edits + confidence + verify)

name: scan_file
